policies.name: Mandatory Shipment Identifier Completeness
policies.description: At least 99.0% of records must carry a non-null shipment identifier.

policies.name: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 Destination Compliance
policies.description: 100% of destination country codes must conform to approved ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

policies.name: Physical Container Weight Bounds (Canonical KG)
policies.description: Normalized gross weight must be strictly positive and not exceed the 30,000 kg container limit.

policies.name: Telemetry Sync Freshness SLA
policies.description: All exported shipment records must have been synchronized within the last 24 hours.

policies.name: Cross-Column Delivery Chronology & Status Integrity
policies.description: Delivery timestamp cannot precede dispatch timestamp, and DELIVERED shipments cannot lack a delivery timestamp.
